cases.name: an answer older than its question is a leftover of an earlier run: wait ignores it
the same leftover keeps the question visible to watch, with the since to re-arm
ask appends the question as FX-n, answer accepts the object wait prints, then wait returns it
cases.cmd: W={{FIX}}/b-{{SID}}.jsonl; rm -f $W; echo '{"batch": "F1", "sheet": "x", "kind": "stop", "context": "x", "questions": [{"id": "q1", "severity": "Bloquant", "question": "x ?", "evidence": "x", "options": [], "recommendation": ""}]}' | python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-question.py ask $W F1 && echo '{"batch": "F1", "sheet": "x", "kind": "stop", "context": "x", "questions": [{"id": "q1", "severity": "Bloquant", "question": "x ?", "evidence": "x", "options": [], "recommendation": ""}]}' | python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-question.py ask $W F1 && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-question.py answer $W F1-1 '{"answers": [{"id": "q1", "text": "oui"}]}' >/dev/null && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-question.py wait $W F1-1 --seconds 1 && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/run-question.py pending $W

cases.name: an answer appended after its question is returned
watch takes the run folder, reads its work file and prints the question JSON on the next line
answer refuses answers that do not cover exactly the question ids
